engine_requirements: New adapter html_cards: GET adapter_config.url (plain HTTP, UA as usual, no cookies). Parse every element matching li whose class contains listing; status = open|closed from class. For each card: title = text of first h3; description = text of first p; deadline_text = text of h4.grant-deadline; url = href of a.learn. Deadline regex: (Closed|Opens|Open|Deadline|Due)[^:]*:\s*(Mon D, YYYY)( H:MM AM/PM)?. Map to opportunity rows: external_id = slug(title), title, url, status, deadline. If match_title is set, emit only the matching card. Treat zero cards as a parse failure, not an empty result. Store the closed card as a row with status closed so the Open transition is detected on the next run.
